packageRules.description: The fleet_view step's python-version 3.9 is the Mac's interpreter contract (Muster runs /usr/bin/python3, and scripts/fleet_view/tests/test_python39.py enforces the pin), not a dependency to bump.

The hosted ST-MCP Worker holds bot keys and runs its own OAuth server:  the fleet's two-week rule, and no automerge, because its path-filtered workerd check is not required and Renovate merged package.json bumps here without a matching lockfile (#408).

AFC-616 fleet_view must run on real Python 3.9 for the Mac/Muster interpreter contract. PR2221 pins this CI job to Ubuntu24.04 because26.04 has no matching setup-python build. Revisit with verified3.9 availability or an explicitly changed interpreter contract; do not undo the pin through runner dependency updates.
